budgetScope: Three-hour wall bound; coupled resolution estimate is not an ETA

nativeRuntimeProof.scope: Retained source hashes and native runtime proof; no post-exit process remapping

freshRepairAttempt.rationale: Synthetic false-work-rejection class demonstrated; symmetric pair-difference deviator is algebraically equal. Original mean/q/branch/law/checks/tolerances retained; optional failure-only owned diagnostics added.
freshRepairAttempt.initialState: Fresh original zero-stress/zero-velocity initial state, same6s/SRF1.6/h0.5
freshRepairAttempt.failureCauseLimit: Missing actual failed trial/predicate remains unavailable; synthetic witness is not actual cause proof.
freshRepairAttempt.trajectoryLimit: New evaluation can round apex fields differently; no identity with the old5.2s trajectory is promised.
freshRepairAttempt.stopRule: One fresh repaired attempt; no SRF/grid/duration/strength/psi/tolerance escalation; registered observers and physical limits remain.

actualObservations.idMappingConvention: VTK unique IDs stable across frames; CSV IDs are captured vector indices, not assumed equal to unique IDs
